original.statement: The computed artifact diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles shows that status.artifact.digest is newly required in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema of helmcharts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, and HelmChart objects that omit it are rejected.

corrected.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmChart schema, status.artifact.digest is now required. A v1beta2 HelmChart is exposed when it has a status.artifact without a digest; HelmCharts with no status.artifact are not affected.

decision.reason: The validated diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] shows that `status.artifact.digest` is now required in the HelmChart v1beta2 schema. A required property nested in an object is only enforced when that parent object is present. So a HelmChart is rejected only when it has a `status.artifact` with no `digest`. The proposed condition only tests for `digest` unset, so it also flags HelmCharts that have no `status.artifact` at all, such as newly created ones, and that is too broad.
